item.description: Nature Medicine, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41591-026-00059-7 In a phase 3 study, children with obesity lost significantly more weight with semaglutide than with placebo, with more than one third achieving a body mass index below the threshold for obesity.
